provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.syntax.heap.nodes against rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:identifier, rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:args, rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:label, rust:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:parse, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::facts_render_unicode_fields_and_reference_kinds, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::arrays_materialize_uninitialized_slots_and_validate_indices, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::variable_store_groups_slots_without_becoming_a_reference_target, test:mdbook-dada/src/graph.rs:tests::labels_are_escaped_and_quoted_commas_are_preserved, test:mdbook-dada/tests/renderer_contracts.rs:diagram_forward_references_and_aliases_preserve_distinct_edges. parse records nodes before resolving assignments, permits the listed object/primitive/array/variable constructors and distinguishes owner, showned, lease and shared-lease edges. args preserves quoted commas and label uses JSON escapes. Tests cover Unicode fields, forward references, aliases, one variable group, empty array slots and label escaping; the unit explicitly treats this as diagram syntax rather than language semantics. This unit introduces its own objects and notation; it has no explicit :uses: prerequisites.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
